nom: florence by mills Feed Your Soul Love U A Latte Coffee Glow Mask

avis.texte: This is a face scrub that is not for the faint of heart because the coffee in it really scrubs! I personally love that though and the coffee scent is heavenly. Plus it also moisturizes! All around great Scrub and definitely a repeat purchase for me.
This makes my face look so refreshed and the coffee smell is amazing. Definitely will be buying this again.

I debated getting this because I have sensitive skin and I'm in my 30's, so I'm a bit more cautious about trying random products. I used it as a face mask instead of a scrub for this reason. The smell is heavenly, my skin feels soft and not irritated, and it was easy to work into my self care night.

I apply the face mask and let it set for about 20 minutes. Then I add water and use it as a facial scrub. When I rinse it off my skin feels soft, moisturized, smooth and clean. The scent is yummy. It really does smell like a plain coffee latte! Enjoyable to use and effective skin care!

This product is very good! I really want to buy it again! If you were looking for something soothing for the skin and it looks really good as well, then this is for you! It smells so good! The only downside that I can think of is the fact that sometimes the little coffee beans are still on your face, but it's easy to get off!

avis.titre: This was truly unexpected! A fantastic facial cleanser
avis.texte: I received a full bottle of this as a "free gift with purchase". I did not think I would like it but regardless, I put it in my shower as I rotate cleansers. I usually keep 4-5 bottles. I read that you can use this as a daily cleanser or keep it on and use it as sort of a mask. I am super prone to redness, so initially I used this cleanser as my once a week "exfoliate". However, I noticed it was much more gentle on my skin and left it feeling soft with a soft pretty glow thus I went to using it around two times a week and I just finished the bottle and I have to say I am super bummed that I am out of it! I am 35 so this line was definitely not created for me but because of receiving this free gift I have absolutely fallen in love with this cleanser and recommend it to people even my age with sensitive skin. It is truly a great product! I appreciate the coffee smell as well. I am prompted to leave this review becuase I am so surprised that I liked it enough to use up the entire bottle and now actually buy a new one!
One of my favorite coffee washes. Very easy to wash off, smells just like coffee and makes my face feel refreshed.

I love this face wash! I usually use coffee masks but hard to find. And I found this brand that had good reviews. It's a good wake up face wash, makes my face feel smooth and glowy. The smell isn't strong either, Definitely recommend..
This mask + scrub combo is surprisingly good! Not drying at all. I use it whenever my skin looks a little dull and it instantly glows.

I'm 36 years old and I use this mask. I think it is a wonderful product. First off, it smells like fresh coffee beans. I use it as a mask and then when I rinse I scrub well so after I let the product sit for 15-20 min, I then exfoliate with it. The little coffee grains do a great job at exfoliation and when its rinsed off I see an immediately glow. The next morning my skin feels fresh and soft.

Second the consistency, while it could be a little thicker it seems to spread well and doesn't drip off the face and though the scrubbing grounds look sparse, it is the perfect amount to remove dead skin cells while not being too abrasive. avis.titre: My Face Never Felt So Good!

I usually do not like the smell of coffee all that much, but I found the scent to be warm and not overpowering.
